It is fixed in github.com/go-git/go-git/v5 5.19.0 (https://github.com/go-git/go-git/security/advisories/GHSA-389r-gv7p-r3rp, https://pkg.go.dev/vuln/GO-2026-5074, https://github.com/go-git/go-git/releases/tag/v5.19.0). Checked every scout-cli-dev package published for Alpine 3.23 in the DHI Alpine repository by 2026-11-27: 25 builds, 1.20.4-r1 to 1.30.0-r1, each for x86_64 and aarch64. Each holds /usr/bin/docker-scout, the -dev build of the Docker Scout CLI, a Go program built with CGO_ENABLED=0; we read its Go build information from every published package. github.com/go-git/go-git/v5 is v5.18.0 in 1.20.4-r1 to 1.20.4-r2, v5.19.0 in 1.20.4-r3 to 1.20.4-r4, v5.19.1 in 1.21.0-r0 to 1.23.1-r4, v5.19.2 in 1.23.1-r5 to 1.30.0-r1; both architectures agree for every build. We listed the symbols of the binaries for 1.20.4-r1 and 1.20.4-r2, the builds before the fix, on both architectures with go tool nm and searched each whole binary for the function names (the Go function name table also lists inlined functions): each contains github.com/go-git/go-git/v5/plumbing/object.(*Commit).Decode, object.(*Tag).Decode, object.DecodeObject and object.GetCommit, functions the advisory lists, so the affected object parsing is linked in those builds. The range ends at 1.20.4-r3, the first build with go-git 5.19.0.

CVE-2026-45022: github.com/go-git/go-git/v5 before 5.19.0 may decode malformed commit and tag object headers differently from Git, and signs or verifies commits over its re-encoded copy of the object rather than the raw object bytes; it is fixed in 5.19.0 (https://github.com/go-git/go-git/security/advisories/GHSA-389r-gv7p-r3rp, https://pkg.go.dev/vuln/GO-2026-5074, https://github.com/go-git/go-git/releases/tag/v5.19.0). Each of the 38 published trivy-dev builds for Alpine 3.23 (0.69.1-r0 to 0.74.0-r12), on both x86_64 and aarch64, was downloaded, checked against the repository index checksum and read for this decision; each holds one file, /usr/bin/trivy, a statically linked Go binary. Its Go build information shows github.com/go-git/go-git/v5 5.16.5 to 5.18.0 in builds before 0.70.0-r2 and 5.19.0 to 5.19.2 from 0.70.0-r2 on, and no github.com/go-git/go-git/v6 in any build. The Go symbol table (go tool nm function entries) of every build contains functions the advisory lists as vulnerable in github.com/go-git/go-git/v5/plumbing/object, including DecodeCommit, DecodeTag, DecodeObject, Commit.Decode and Tag.Decode, with runtime.main found in each binary as a control, so the vulnerable package is linked and the fixed version is the first build carrying go-git 5.19.0.

It is fixed in github.com/go-git/go-git/v5 5.19.0 (https://github.com/go-git/go-git/security/advisories/GHSA-389r-gv7p-r3rp, https://pkg.go.dev/vuln/GO-2026-5074, https://github.com/go-git/go-git/releases/tag/v5.19.0). Checked every scout-cli package published for Debian 13 in the DHI Debian repository by 2026-11-27: 25 builds, 1.20.4-1 to 1.30.0-1, each for amd64 and arm64. Each installs one file, /usr/bin/docker-scout, the Docker Scout CLI; in every build that binary carries the same Go build ID (which includes a hash of the linked program) as the Alpine 3.23 scout-cli build of the same version and architecture, a Go program built with CGO_ENABLED=0 whose Go build information we read. github.com/go-git/go-git/v5 is v5.18.0 in 1.20.4-1 to 1.20.4-2, v5.19.0 in 1.20.4-3 to 1.20.4-4, v5.19.1 in 1.21.0-0 to 1.23.1-4, v5.19.2 in 1.23.1-5 to 1.30.0-1; both architectures agree for every build. We listed the symbols of the Alpine 3.23 scout-cli binaries that are byte-identical to the Debian ones (the same MD5 as the Debian package lists) for 1.20.4-1 and 1.20.4-2, the builds before the fix, on both architectures with go tool nm and searched each whole binary for the function names (the Go function name table also lists inlined functions): each contains github.com/go-git/go-git/v5/plumbing/object.(*Commit).Decode, object.(*Tag).Decode, object.DecodeObject and object.GetCommit, functions the advisory lists, so the affected object parsing is linked in those builds. The range ends at 1.20.4-3, the first build with go-git 5.19.0.
